name: menubar-33
description: Locale menubar with language and date format radios and a sample date formatted by the selection.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CalendarIcon, LanguagesIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Menubar, MenubarContent, MenubarMenu, MenubarRadioGroup, MenubarRadioItem, MenubarTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/menubar" const languages = [ { value: "en-US", label: "English (US)" }, { value: "de-DE", label: "Deutsch" }, { value: "fr-FR", label: "Français" }, { value: "ja-JP", label: "日本語" }, ] export default function LanguageRegionMenubar() { const [locale, setLocale] = React.useState("en-US") const [style, setStyle] = React.useState<"short" | "long">("long") const sample = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: style }).format( new Date(2026, 2, 14) ) return (
Language {languages.map((lang) => ( {lang.label} ))} Dates Short Long

Preview: {sample}

) }
